tour.windowTitle: How to use the Catalog tab

search.title: Find a model
search.body: Three sources: Recommended (curated), Search HF (all of Hugging Face) and Installed (already on disk). Type to filter or search, and narrow by capability chips — chat, vision, image gen, TTS and more.

hardware.title: Your hardware, detected
hardware.body: This strip is your real machine — RAM, GPU, VRAM and CPU cores. Every fit verdict below is computed from these numbers, not from generic requirements.

fit.title: Will it fit?
fit.body: Local models get a fit pill — FITS / TIGHT / CPU-ONLY / NO FIT — plus a VRAM estimate, computed from YOUR GPU and RAM above. FITS means fast on GPU; TIGHT may run out of memory mid-generation.

download.title: Download & run
download.body: DOWNLOAD opens the quant picker with the recommended quant for your hardware highlighted — smaller quants trade quality for fit. Once installed, the button becomes RUN: it loads the model and drops you into a chat with it.
